title: SvgFeOffset
responsibility: Renders the native feOffset element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeOffset.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte snippet supplied as the element's children; when present, the component invokes it and renders its output inside the native feOffset element. If omitted, no child content is rendered.

outputs.name: SvgFeOffset
outputs.description: The native feOffset markup element with all component properties other than children spread as attributes. Supplied children are rendered inside it, and the component adds no wrapper element.
